meta.source: Figma: ⚙️ Foundation (avzbRTP9CgpbbO8NgU5Ymo), 🕹️ Buttons (AXEkdklBHSQDssRmOFMTve), 🧭 Navigation (7qHX6LqdotAU59Jr5UIsfw) and 🃏 Cards (mg7egvNbr2ciMP04Ig2XDl), read 8 November 2026; Foundation › Layout re-read 9 November 2026 (Buttons/XS, MD, LR; Scale/44); Foundation checked in sync 9 November 2026, 23:00; 🍟 Chips (VVGHy0fAHuPqL6dhBD5Ai6) › `_Chips Setup` and 📻 Switches, Checkbox and Radio (zhcTb4a0XbF3YeYF9XI6zw) › `_Switches Setup`, read 11 November 2026; Foundation › Effects re-read 11 November 2026 (Opcaity/None, Border/None, Glass/Bottom) Re-read 14 November 2026: Foundation (variables and text styles unchanged; new effect style Glass/Andriod Blur) and Buttons (Buttons Colors, Buttons Setup, _Button_Master Of Masters, _Button Trail). Re-read 17 November 2026: Foundation › 🎨 Colors › Glass BG (12 variants) and `_Glass BG Master` (all layers and effects).
meta.release: 2026-11-17 (3.11): `glass-rim` softens the white band at the bottom of Glass BG: inset 0 −8 10 −4 at 75% (was 0 −6 3 −1 at 90%), at the DL Advisor's request on the design system (17 November). No other value changed. Previous: 2026-11-17 (3.10): Glass BG as Figma builds it. New `shadow-os`, `glass-rim`, `glass-rim-dark` (shadow), `blur-frost` (blur) and a `gradient` group with the five Glass BG fills, all read from ⚙️ Foundation › Glass BG and `_Glass BG Master` on 17 November 2026. Blur tokens keep the Figma radius; CSS blur is half of it (usage text corrected). No existing value changed. Previous: 2026-11-15 (3.9): chip paddings follow 🍟 Chips › _Chips Setup as published 15 Nov (Glob Whitespace 8/10/12/14, Icon-Side Whitespace 6/8/10/12; heights, icons, gaps and font sizes unchanged). 2026-11-14 (3.8): layout modes as data, and every effect style checked against Foundation. `glass-full`: the inner shadow is 2% as in `Glass/Full` (was 3%). Every spacing, dimension and button-height token that Foundation › Layout varies by mode now carries `modes` (phone, tablet, wide), read from Figma on 14 November 2026; the phone value stays `value`. Previous: 2026-11-14 (3.7): 🕹️ Buttons and ⚙️ Foundation re-read. `button-fate-surface` is now `Alerts/Surface/Solid Error` at 10% (#ff41361a; was #fff2f1), `button-secondary-surface-on-dark` gains its 70% (#303336b3), new `glass-android` (effect style `Glass/Andriod Blur`). No other value changed. Previous: 2026-11-11 (3.6): tokens from three more DL files and three missing Foundation values. Added `chip-*` (24, from 🍟 Chips › _Chips Setup), `control-*` (21, from 📻 Switches, Checkbox and Radio › _Switches Setup), `opacity-none`, `border-none` and `glass-bottom` (⚙️ Foundation). No value changed. Previous: 2026-11-11 (3.5): button padding. `button-padding-*` 28 / 22 / 18 / 14 (was 32 / 30 / 22 / 16) and `button-padding-icon-*` 24 / 20 / 16 / 12 (was 26 / 24 / 20 / 14), LR / MD / SM / XS (🕹️ Buttons › Buttons Setup › Glob Whitespace, Icon-Side Whitespace). Icon-only and loading buttons now use the icon-side padding on both sides. Previous: 2026-11-10 (3.4): no value changed. `button-padding-icon-*` now applies to every filled button with a left or right icon, not only destructive ones (🕹️ Buttons › _Button Trail).

tokens.name: glass-android
tokens.usage: Glass fallback where the native glass material is missing (Android, web). Pair with `backdrop-filter: blur(calc(var(--blur-md) / 2))` (Figma blur 10 = CSS blur 5px). Effect style `Glass/Andriod Blur` (Figma spelling): background blur 10 + inner shadow 0 5, blur 10, spread 10, Ink at 5%. Used by `_Glass BG Master` Glass=Off and by the button `glass` prop. Added 14 November 2026; pairing corrected 17 November 2026.

tokens.name: shadow-os
tokens.usage: Effect style `Shadow/OS` (⚙️ Foundation, added 17 November 2026; three drops: −2 0 2, 2 0 2 and 0 0 1 spread 0.5, #1A1C1F at 5%). The Shadows layer of every Glass BG (`Shadows / Type=OS`) and of Select Card.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Web stand-in for the Glass Effect layer of Glass BG (Dark=Off): Figma's GLASS effect (specular light 0.25) plus inner shadows 0 ±40 r10 s−40 #282828 linear dodge and 0 40 r30 s−40 #E6E6E6 linear burn. CSS has no blend modes for box-shadow, so the rim is set by eye against Figma's render (17 November 2026): a 1px white line on top, a soft white band at the bottom (0 −8 10 −4 at 75%, softened 17 November 2026 at the DL Advisor's request; was 0 −6 3 −1 at 90%), a soft top glow and a faint top shade. Pair with `backdrop-filter: blur(calc(var(--blur-frost) / 2))`. Added 17 November 2026.

tokens.name: glass-rim-dark
tokens.usage: As `glass-rim` for Glass BG Dark=On, where both dodge shadows are #1A1A1A: 1px light lines top and bottom, soft glows at 14%. Added 17 November 2026.
